hikes.name: Lake Twenty-Two
hikes.blurb: Up through old-growth cedars beside a run of cascades to a lake under Mt Pilchuck's north face.

hikes.name: Mount Pilchuck Lookout
hikes.blurb: Over boulders to a lookout on a rock summit, Puget Sound to the west and the Cascades to the east.

hikes.name: Heather Lake
hikes.blurb: A steady forest climb to a lake in a cirque on Pilchuck's flank.

hikes.name: Big Four Ice Caves
hikes.blurb: An easy boardwalk and forest walk to avalanche snow at the foot of Big Four Mountain (look, don't enter).

hikes.name: Mount Dickerman
hikes.blurb: Nearly 4,000 feet of climbing to a meadow summit with a giant view of Glacier Peak and Big Four.

hikes.name: Goat Lake
hikes.blurb: Up an old wagon road along Elliott Creek to a lake ringed with peaks and a falls at its outlet.

hikes.name: Gothic Basin
hikes.blurb: A rough, steep trail past waterfalls to a stark basin of polished rock and a lake under Del Campo Peak.

hikes.name: Monte Cristo
hikes.blurb: An old road along the Sauk to a ghost-town mining camp in a cirque of peaks.
